about: Folder rules of the API sources (Syzygy ADR-0008 §6), checked by scripts/check-api-layers.mjs on resolved import paths. Globs are relative to services/api/src: `*` is one path segment or part of one, `**` any number of segments. A component is mind/<c> (mind/action/<c> for actions), surfaces/<s>, integrations/<i>, infra/<x>, wiring, contracts, or the entry files at the root. Until wave 5 the check reports and never fails; today's violations are in scripts/api-layers-baseline.json, which may only shrink.

rules.description: Only the entry files (moves.json `entries`: what a systemd unit, the Agent Host plist or a package.json script runs) live at the root of the API sources, and they stay there.
A part of the mind reaches another part only through that part's window: ports.ts, or <component>Ports.ts (Syzygy ADR-0008 §10, so that basenames stay unique, e.g. inhibitionPorts.ts).

A part's window (ports.ts or <component>Ports.ts) re-exports only types from a store/ folder (`export type`, `import type`, or every name marked `type`): a store is handed to a part by wiring, never reached through another part's window (Syzygy ADR-0008 stage 3, S1).
Only a store/ folder, infra/sqlite and wiring open SQLite.
A surface does not import another surface.

A surface is handed its stores by wiring; it imports no store of another component and not infra/sqlite (its own store/ folder is its own). A surface's own store/ folder may import infra/sqlite (coordinator decision approved by the owner, Syzygy ADR-0008 stage 3, owner answer 5).
An integration does not import the mind, except a part's window, ports.ts or <component>Ports.ts (contracts/ is open to everyone).
Only the entry files and wiring itself import wiring.

process.env is read only in infra/config (serverEnvironment.ts), wiring and the entry files; every other module takes its settings as a parameter that defaults to serverEnvironment() (none left in the baseline since Syzygy ADR-0008 stage 2).

Her own time (mind/action/ownTime) opens no conversation store (the companion store and its repositories), memory (the memory outbox and its writer among it), recall, emotion, conversation response path (mind/action/respond: dailyMind; and a turn's cognitive context, turnCognitiveContext, in the workspace since stage 3), disclosure gate or its window (disclosurePorts), perception, workspace (Syzygy ADR-0008 stage 3: she is handed one function, emitMindEvent), conversation model, HTTP layer or conversational surface (text, voice, platform), as autonomyLoopPrivacy.test.ts allows the loop modules. The one reader of the owner's context, autonomyOwnerContext.ts, reads through the conversation's entry points and is the exception (AGENTS.md, Bounded autonomy).
The owner's context reaches her own time in one way: the worker opens it through autonomyOwnerContextWiring.ts, which alone imports autonomyOwnerContext.ts.
The interface her loop is handed of the owner's context imports nothing but vocabulary.
The awake clock (the one write of the loop's process to the companion state) imports its timing, the mood history and their contract, and nothing else; only the autonomy worker imports it.
Only the autonomy worker imports the awake clock.
The pure packages hold no database, network, environment or timer: they import only @shannon/* and their own files.

rules.label: sql
rules.description: Wiring holds no SQL (Syzygy ADR-0009 D9): it hands stores to parts and reads through store methods. Counted per file (prepared statements and literal exec calls); a count may only fall.

rules.label: mind_actions
rules.description: The table mind_actions is named only by its store (mind/action/threads/store) and the migrations (Syzygy ADR-0009 D2: one lease layer, one reader). Counted per file; a count may only fall.

rules.label: ddl
rules.description: CREATE and ALTER live only in the migrations (Syzygy ADR-0009 stage 1 plan). Counted per file; a count may only fall (enforced since S9).

rules.label: PRAGMA
rules.description: PRAGMA lives only in the one function that opens the database (infra/sqlite/sqliteOpen.ts; Syzygy ADR-0009 stage 1 plan). Counted per file; a count may only fall (enforced since S9).
